title: Leave type: medical vs maternity (approval question)
source: Loan officers ask how to count income for a borrower on leave who returns before the first payment.
turns: fannie conventional purchase. my borrower is an RN, 4 yrs at the hospital, base pay 8k/mo. she's on {cue} right now getting short term disability pay of 4,800/mo, and she goes back to work dec 1, which is before the first payment. 735 score, debts 600/mo, housing pmt 2556, 60k in checking, needs 44.5k to close. what income can i use and can i get her approved?
ok what do i need from her and her employer for the leave part? can you write me the needs list email to her, short and friendly

bottom line: can i approve her for fannie conventional? Reply with one JSON object only: {{"decision": "approve" | "deny" | "refer", "qualifying_monthly_income": number, "conditions": [strings], "reason": string}}
gold: approve; qualifying income $8,000 (returns before first payment, B3-3.3-09); no questions about future leave or children (B3-3.3-09; Reg B 1002.6(b)(3))
